body: The swipe-from-edge gesture implementation has potential race conditions and memory leak issues. The `touchStartX` variable is not a ref and will be recreated on each effect run, causing the closure to capture stale values. Additionally, the effect lacks `isMobile` in its dependency array but uses it in the callback. Consider using `useRef` for `touchStartX` or restructuring the effect to properly handle dependencies.

The long-press timer is not cleaned up if the component unmounts while a touch is in progress. This can lead to memory leaks and potential errors when trying to call `onDateClick` after unmount. Add a cleanup function in `useEffect` or ensure the timer is cleared in component unmount.

The resize event listener is added without any throttling or debouncing, which can cause excessive re-renders on window resize. Consider using a debounced or throttled version of the handler to improve performance, especially on lower-end devices where resize events can fire very frequently.

The search input is missing accessibility attributes. Add an `aria-label` or associated `<label>` element to ensure screen reader users can understand the purpose of this input field.
```suggestion
            placeholder="Search locations…"
            aria-label="Search locations"
```

The bottom navigation bar may render outside the `<Sidebar>` component but inside the `<DndContext.Provider>`, which could cause layout and focus management issues. The bottom navigation should be rendered outside both the Sidebar and DndContext.Provider, or properly integrated within the Sidebar structure. Also note the closing tag placement suggests the navigation bar is outside the Sidebar but the indentation is misleading.

The long-press timer is not cleaned up if the component unmounts while a touch is in progress. This can lead to memory leaks and potential errors when trying to call `onDateClick` after unmount. Add a cleanup function in `useEffect` or ensure the timer is cleared in component unmount.

The mobile carousel uses `w-[85vw]` for widget width, but doesn't account for the gap between widgets. With `gap-3` (0.75rem/12px), users will need to scroll past the gap to see the next widget properly snapped. Consider adjusting the widget width calculation to be `w-[calc(85vw-0.75rem)]` or using scroll-padding to account for the gap, ensuring smooth snap-scrolling between widgets.
```suggestion
            style={{ scrollPaddingInline: `${gap * 0.25}rem` }}
```

The @object-ui/mobile package is added to the external array and globals mapping, which is correct for a peer dependency. However, the package.json lists it as a regular dependency (not a peer dependency). This mismatch means the build configuration treats it as external, but package managers will still bundle it. Either move @object-ui/mobile to peerDependencies in package.json, or remove it from the external array if it should be bundled with the plugin.

The swipe indicator handle (the gray bar) is added but there's no corresponding swipe-to-dismiss functionality implemented. This creates a misleading UX pattern where users expect to be able to swipe down to close the dialog. Either implement the swipe-to-dismiss gesture or remove the visual indicator to avoid user confusion.

The resize event listener is added without any throttling or debouncing, which can cause excessive re-renders on window resize. Consider using a debounced or throttled version of the handler to improve performance, especially on lower-end devices where resize events can fire very frequently.

The column count and swipe indicator are always visible on mobile (using `flex sm:hidden`), but they're placed outside the scrollable container. Consider whether these indicators should be sticky or if they should scroll with the content. Also, the indicators appear above the kanban board which might interfere with other UI elements depending on the parent layout.

The metadata panel layout change from `flex-row` to `flex-col sm:flex-row` doesn't appear to be related to any actual metadata panel in the visible diff. Looking at the structure, this seems to control the layout of the main content area and potentially a sidebar, but there's no visible metadata panel in the diff. The class name and comment in the PR description don't match the actual code change. Please verify this is the intended change or update the PR description.

According to the architectural guidelines, plugins should isolate heavy dependencies and use peer dependencies for shared libraries. The @object-ui/mobile package is a shared utility package (not a heavy 3rd-party library), and should be treated as a peer dependency like @object-ui/react and @object-ui/components. Consider moving @object-ui/mobile to peerDependencies in the plugin packages to ensure version consistency and avoid bundle bloat.
